steps.instruction: Check head/cylinder and crankcase/cover joints for pressure/oil leaks and cooling-system leakage. Check silencer body/stay for cracks/leaks and engine mounts for loosening. Record the actual repaired-part fit and contact inspection with the repair specialist where needed. Accepted old dimensions alone are not a fresh inspection of inaccessible surfaces; any suspect fit must be resolved before completion.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.

steps.title: Inspect chassis and wheels
steps.instruction: Check frame, swingarm, linkage and bracket welds/mounts for cracks/looseness; wheels for damage/runout and bearing play. A tilted tire valve indicates tire movement requiring correction. Check fork/shock smooth operation, leaks and mounts. Raise front wheel, rock lower fork legs to check steering play and turn both ways; binding/play needs separate steering service.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.

steps.title: Check spokes progressively
steps.instruction: Compare spoke tones by tapping: loose spokes sound dull. Replace bent/damaged spokes through the separate wheel repair. Tighten sound loose nipples progressively to 2.5 N·m, never a half-turn or more per adjustment. Continue staged checks until initial looseness disappears; record unresolved wheel faults.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.

steps.title: Set chain alignment and slack
steps.instruction: With the rear wheel raised and transmission neutral, pull up the chain about 50 N above the guide mounting bolt and measure the illustrated guide-to-chain gap: 50–60 mm. To adjust, loosen axle nut and both locknuts; adjust sides equally and push wheel forward to seat both end plates. Tighten axle 135 N·m and locknuts 21 N·m, then recheck alignment/slack. Lubricate the chain. A stiff, damaged or worn chain requires separate cleaning/removal or replacement and clip closure; do not hide that work behind this inspection.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.

steps.title: Inspect and lubricate controls
steps.instruction: Check both brakes for effective action without drag and the front-lever end for no free play. With reservoirs horizontal, fluid must be above the minimum marks in the diagram. Leaks or spongy action require separate brake service. Check cable-clutch free play at 7.0–12.0 mm: turn the handlebar adjuster; if insufficient, slide the cable cover, loosen its locknut, adjust at the cable, tighten that locknut to 4.3 N·m and restore the cover. Check smooth clutch action and unrestricted cable travel through full steering. Replace damaged cables; lubricate rough sound cables with engine oil or suitable cable lubricant at the upright cable end. Use silicone grease at brake-lever moving contacts and lithium-soap grease at clutch-lever and pedal pivots.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.

steps.title: Record the required tank-interior service
steps.instruction: The post-break-in list requires cleaning inside the fuel tank and checking for leaks. Record actual qualified cleaning; the cleaning method remains external. Extract fuel with a pump; remove the fuel-cap cover before the seat, then left/right side covers and scoops. Cover residual-pressure fittings with cloth, release holder/cover and both connector buttons by hand, protect disconnected joints and support tank off its pump face. If pump removed, renew gasket lip upward, align pump projection with bracket slot and tighten SIX bolts in diagram274 numbered order to4Nm. Restore four tank dampers and retained collars, tighten two front mounts7Nm and rear retaining screw9Nm. Reconnect hose until click, lock cover/holder and connect pump coupler. Route BOTH hose and pump lead through cover guide without pinch/kink. Record actual sealing and leak checks.
steps.verification: Record actual completion of this step, correct illustrated orientation and stated fastening/closure; unresolved damage, leakage or required external work remains pending.

steps.title: Restore access panels
steps.instruction: Refit both air scoops with their projections in aircase holes, grooves over ribs and remaining projections in slots; fasteners7Nm. Restore right-cover projections and slots, keeping its rib below the rear-fender rib. Refit aircase cover with rear slots over case edges and side ribs aligned with scoop projections; secure quick fastener and restore breather. Slide seat forward and tighten its two bolts22Nm; restore left cover and ordinary cover fasteners7Nm. Refit fuel-cap cover with plastic bands fully under seat. Confirm connectors, wire clearance, fuel connections, drain/filter/filler and verified oil-check-bolt closure before restart.
steps.verification: Record actual completion of this step, correct illustrated orientation and stated fastening/closure; unresolved damage, leakage or required external work remains pending.

steps.title: Complete every applicable torque check
steps.instruction: Complete the post-break-in fastener checks using the linked joint table and its preparation conditions: frame/engine/seat, steering, suspension/linkage/pivot, wheels/spokes/sprocket, brake/clutch fasteners, fuel pump, shift pedal and bodywork. Record each joint or link the actual inspection sheet. Inaccessible/unidentified joints remain pending. Do not substitute generic torques or open hydraulic unions merely to create a check. Lower steering-ring preload requires its separate staged service. No completion with unresolved required checks.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.

steps.title: Check flow at idle
steps.instruction: Start fully assembled engine at idle only and watch oil window for flow and decreasing level. Stop immediately if level does not decrease; diagnose lubrication before proceeding. Do not rev it to force a successful check.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.

steps.title: Verify settled oil level
steps.instruction: With bike upright on level ground, warm for2–3minutes, stop and wait about1minute. Check that oil is above the window minimum mark. Remove the oil-check bolt: oil must not flow out; if it does, drain excess until the last drop stops. Add specified oil if at/below minimum. Restore the bolt and its seal using verified exact closure information and record actual fastening and leak-free closure; no nearby cover torque is a substitute. Both window and check-bolt criteria must pass.
steps.verification: Record2–3minute warm-up, approximately1minute wait, above-minimum window, no excess from check opening, and actual verified oil-check-bolt/seal closure. Stop completion if exact closure remains unresolved.

steps.title: Record actual maintenance completion
steps.instruction: After the engine is fully cool, check coolant at the illustrated maximum and confirm no continuing loss. Open a radiator cap only cold, using a thick cloth and slow release to the detent; wait for hissing to stop before pressing/turning it off, and secure it after checking. Repeat the pre-operation checklist. Complete only with actual pressure-test, riding, oil/debris, generator, repaired-part fit, tank-cleaning, chassis and all-joint records accepted. Missing required work remains pending.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
